back: Union of Austria with Germany, March 1938, forbidden by the Treaty of Versailles.
Avoiding war by giving way to an aggressor's demands that seemed reasonable; linked with Chamberlain.

front: When did German troops enter Austria?

back: Hitler, Mussolini, Chamberlain and Daladier (not Czechoslovakia or the USSR).

front: Give the three meetings of the Sudeten crisis in order.
back: Berchtesgaden (15 September), Bad Godesberg (22-23 September), Munich (29-30 September 1938).
Fear of war after 1914-18, British unreadiness, belief Versailles was unfair, lack of support from Dominions, USA and France (also fear of communism).
It encouraged Hitler, sacrificed Czechoslovakia's army and defences, and alienated the USSR.
